name: Account Locked
subject: Your account has been locked - {{app.name}}
markup:
<re-html>
    <re-head>
        <re-title>
            Your account has been locked - {{app.name}}
        </re-title>
    </re-head>
    <re-body background-color="#fff" padding="48px 24px 48px 24px">
        <re-preheader>
            Your account has been locked
        </re-preheader>
        <re-header padding="16px 24px 8px 24px">
            <re-text font-size="18px" font-weight="bold" line-height="26px" color="#111827">
                {{> app_logo}}
            </re-text>
        </re-header>
        <re-main background-color="#fff" border-radius="0px">
            <re-block border-radius="0px" align="left" padding="24px 24px 0px 24px" background-color="#ffffff">
                <re-grid>
                    <re-column width="50%">
                        <re-text font-size="16px" font-weight="bold" color="#111827">Account Locked</re-text>
                    </re-column>
                    <re-column width="50%">
                        <re-text font-size="14px" align="right" color="#9ca3af">{{locked_date}}</re-text>
                    </re-column>
                </re-grid>
            </re-block>
            <re-block padding="24px">
                <re-divider background-color="#B7B8C2" height="1px"></re-divider>
            </re-block>
            <re-block padding="0px 24px">
                <re-text font-size="14px" color="#747686" line-height="21px">
                    Your account has been locked. To protect your security, access has been temporarily restricted.
                </re-text>
            </re-block>

            <re-block padding="24px">
                <re-divider background-color="#B7B8C2" height="1px"></re-divider>
            </re-block>

            <re-block padding="0px 24px 0px 24px">
                <re-grid>
                    <re-column width="40%" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                        <re-text font-size="12px" color="#9ca3af">
                            Locked on
                        </re-text>
                    </re-column>
                    <re-column width="60%" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                        <re-text font-size="14px" font-weight="bold" color="#111827" align="right">
                            {{locked_date}}
                        </re-text>
                    </re-column>
                </re-grid>
                <re-grid>
                    <re-column width="40%" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                        <re-text font-size="12px" color="#9ca3af">
                            Failed attempts
                        </re-text>
                    </re-column>
                    <re-column width="60%" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                        <re-text font-size="14px" font-weight="bold" color="#111827" align="right">
                            {{failed_attempts}}
                        </re-text>
                    </re-column>
                </re-grid>
            </re-block>

            <re-block padding="24px">
                <re-divider background-color="#B7B8C2" height="1px"></re-divider>
            </re-block>

            <re-block padding="0px 24px 24px 24px">
                <re-text font-size="14px" color="#747686" font-weight="bold" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                    What happens next?
                </re-text>
                <re-text font-size="14px" color="#747686" line-height="21px" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                    Your account will be automatically unlocked after {{lockout_duration}}. You can also contact an administrator to unlock your account immediately.
                </re-text>
                <re-text font-size="14px" color="#747686" line-height="21px">
                    If you did not expect this, please contact an administrator immediately as your account may be compromised.
                </re-text>
            </re-block>

            <re-block padding="0px 24px 48px 24px">
                <re-text padding="24px 0px 0px 0px" font-size="12px" color="#9ca3af">
                    This is an automated security notification from {{app.name}}.
                </re-text>
            </re-block>
        </re-main>
        <re-footer padding="24px 32px 48px">
        <re-divider background-color="#B7B8C2" height="1px"></re-divider>
        <re-text margin="16px 0px 0px 0px" font-size="13px" color="#747686">© {{current_year}} {{app.name}}</re-text>
    </re-footer>
</re-body>
</re-html>
body:
Your account has been locked

{{> app_logo}}

Account Locked

Your account has been locked. To protect your security, access has been temporarily restricted.

 
Locked on: {{locked_date}}
Failed attempts: {{failed_attempts}}
 

What happens next?

Your account will be automatically unlocked after {{lockout_duration}} (on {{unlock_time}}). You can also contact an administrator to unlock your account immediately.

If you did not expect this, please contact an administrator immediately as your account may be compromised.

This is an automated security notification from {{app.name}}.

{{> footer}}

                    </re-column>
                    <re-column width="50%">

                    Plan

                        </re-text>
                    </re-column>
                </re-grid>
                {{/if}}
                {{/if}}

                        <re-text font-size="12px" color="#757575">
                            Proration

                            Prorated credit for the remainder of your subscription.
                        </re-text>
                    </re-column>
                    <re-column width="50%" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                        <re-text font-size="14px" color="#000000" align="right">
                            -{{proration_credits}}
                        </re-text>
                    </re-column>
                </re-grid>
                {{/if}}
                {{#if has_payer_credits}}

                    <re-column width="50%" valign="middle" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                        <re-text font-size="12px" color="#757575">
                            Credit

                            -{{payer_credits}}

                    </re-column>
                </re-grid>
                {{/if}}
                {{#if has_discount}}
                <re-grid>
                    <re-column width="50%" valign="middle" padding="0px 0px 12px 0px">
                        <re-text font-size="12px" color="#757575">
                            Discount ({{discount_name}})
                        </re-text>
                        <re-text font-size="10px" color="#757575">
                            Discount applied to this payment.{{#if discount_cycles_remaining}} {{discount_cycles_remaining}} cycles remaining.{{/if}}

                </re-grid>
                {{/if}}

                    <re-column width="40%" valign="middle">
                        <re-text font-size="12px" color="#757575">
                            Total due
                        </re-text>
